diagnosis.what_happened: Raw dataset was overwritten directly during data cleaning and missing value imputation.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Overwriting source files destroys audit trails and prevents raw data reproducibility verification.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Raw data must remain permanently immutable; cleaned datasets must be saved to a separate derived file.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Scientific provenance requires that original source datasets remain unmodified so transformations can be reproduced.

desired_behavior: Treat raw empirical datasets as strictly read-only and immutable; always output cleaned datasets to distinct destination paths and record data transformation manifests.
generalization: Never overwrite or modify raw input data files in any data curation, screening, or cleaning stage.

evidence.observed_value: Raw data file modified in place.
